summary_en: 5,000 shares of City Road acquired for ¥111M (¥85M purchase price + ¥26M advisory fees) from two individuals holding 50% each; Japan Creative Platform to acquire remaining 15,000 shares via stock-for-stock merger at ratio 26.16 parent shares per subsidiary share, exchanging 392,400 treasury shares; merger effective Oct 2, 2026 (target), utilizing simplified merger procedure (no shareholder vote required for parent).
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of City Road Co., Ltd. Shares and Acquisition of Wholly-Owned Subsidiary Status through Simplified Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief: On July 3, 2026, Japan Creative Platform Group's board approved the acquisition of City Road Co., Ltd. and its conversion to a wholly-owned subsidiary through a simplified stock exchange. The transaction has two phases: (1) Japan Creative Platform will acquire 5,000 shares (50% of City Road) directly from two individuals—Atsushi Sakagami and Masahito Yamane—for ¥85 million, plus ¥26 million in advisory fees, for a total outlay of ¥111 million. This brings Japan Creative Platform's ownership to 25%. (2) In the second step, Japan Creative Platform will exchange its remaining shares in City Road for 392,400 of its own treasury shares at a ratio of 26.16 parent shares per subsidiary share, resulting in full ownership. The stock exchange is structured as a simplified merger under the Companies Act Article 796(2), requiring no shareholder vote by Japan Creative Platform but requiring City Road shareholder approval (scheduled September 26, 2026). The merger is expected to become effective October 2, 2026. City Road, founded in 1991, operates in outdoor advertising, signage, and promotional services with 35+ years of customer relationships. Management states the merger will accelerate decision-making and enable more efficient deployment of creative solutions across the combined group.
